description: React component for changing multiple notes' types and properties in a web application, including handling of locked notes, super notes, and user permissions.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Generates a group ID string from an EditorMenuGroup object by lowercasing the title and replacing spaces with hyphens.

methods.name: selectComponent
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a note with a specified component, handling conflicts.

methods.name: selectNonComponent
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a note with a specified note type without a component.

methods.name: selectItem
methods.description: Handles selection of a menu item, including permission checks, locked notes, super notes, and editor change confirmations.

methods.name: closeCurrentSuperNoteImporter
methods.description: Closes the super note importer modal, proceeding with the next note or resetting state.

methods.name: handleSuperNoteConversionCompletion
methods.description: Completes the conversion of a super note and proceeds to the next note.
